notes.notes:
[b]Movavi Video Editor Plus 22.2 is all about creating a unique atmosphere in your videos. Here are the new features that will help you achieve that unique vibe:[/b]

[list]
[*]  A pack of trendy animated overlay effects that will boost your visual in a click: enjoy Glitch, Frame, Lasers, Noise, Waves, and other overlays.

[*]  In addition to the built-in LUTs, you can now upload your custom LUTs to get the desired look for your videos.
[/list]

notes.title: Fantastic news!
notes.notes:
[b]Here are just some of the enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Compressor and Gate[/b] audio enhancement tools to reduce the difference between loud and soft noise and set the decibel level. Click just one button to get higher quality sound. And now you can save clips in which the sound is low
[*] [b]New audio effects for sound distortion[/b] – apply them to voice and music as filters. Just drag and drop on the timeline and set the intensity level
[*][b] Sound visualization[/b]. No more complaints about volume jumps in your videos. No more damage to your headphones and eardrums. Now you can see the volume levels during the montage and smooth out everything!
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1783530/extras/Pic_1_ru,_en_%D0%9D%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D0%B0%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BE%D1%8D%D1%84%D1%84%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%8B__%D0%A7%D1%82%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE___1_.png?t=1635417298[/img]
